text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

words.gloss_range: coordinating opening that joins this verdict to the prior outcome while setting up the contrary branch
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah begin as a connected counterpart to the believer verdict in 22:56, not a detached threat. The small bound connector carries the reader into the contrary second branch before any lexical content appears, so coordination and contrast stay live together.

topics.headline: paired verdict opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah as the coordinated negative half of the positive verdict in 22:56.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the coordinating conjunction linking this ayah to the preceding context, and the boundary rows make the paired outcome frame explicit.

topics.headline: single-letter clause link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the transition is carried by the very first bound letter before any lexical content appears.
topics.reason: The opening particle is orthographically minimal but syntactically marks connection rather than leaving the two verdicts separated.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun defining the judged group by completed conduct and preparing the result clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not name a group first and describe it second; it lets the following actions define a specified class. That front-loaded relative frame behaves like the condition side of the verdict, so the later demonstrative re-points only after conduct has fixed the referent.

topics.headline: conduct-defined relative class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are grammatically defined by their actions rather than by a free-standing label.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies a relative clause from word 2 through word 7, and QAC marks the word as the masculine plural relative pronoun.

topics.headline: relative frame before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first clause behaving like a condition whose result will be stated after the demonstrative pivot.
topics.reason: The relative group is resumed in the nominal result clause, so the demonstrative re-identification depends on the prior verbal definition.

words.gloss_range: completed plural act of disbelief, rejection, and ingratitude, objectless here and then sharpened by the following targeted denial
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on covering, concealing, disbelieving, rejecting, and ingratitude, with other family branches not selected by this Form I perfect context
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) defines the group through a completed plural act, with the subject carried inside the verb. Because it is objectless here, it gives a broad inward rejection state before the next verb names the target; the root's covering and ingratitude pressure makes that rejection feel like active suppression of visible evidence rather than neutral non-assent. Form I keeps the blame on the subjects' own act, while causative and expiation family branches remain contrasts: this is covering over truth, not making others reject or covering sin. The verb also joins a rejection-sign-punishment pattern, moving from doubt in 22:55 into verdict here and answering the faith side of the boundary in 22:56; its hard onset makes that turn audible.

topics.headline: completed classifying act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disbelief presented as a completed action that classifies the relative group.
topics.reason: QAC and verb-instance evidence identify a perfect third-person masculine plural Form I verb inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: objectless rejection before targeted denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence moving from broad rejection to a later targeted denial of signs.
topics.reason: The verb instance is objectless, while the following coordinated verb is saturated through a prepositional complement.

topics.headline: covering and ingratitude pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief carries the felt image of covering visible evidence and the moral weight of ingratitude.
topics.reason: The local sense remains disbelief and rejection, while the accepted root field keeps covering and ingratitude as lexical pressure rather than independent branches.

topics.headline: Form I and family-boundary contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the blame kept on the subjects' own act, not shifted to causative disbelief or expiation branches.
topics.reason: The surface is Form I perfect with a plural subject suffix, so nearby family forms remain contrastive pressure only.

topics.headline: rejection network and consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this verb participating in a larger rejection-sign-punishment pattern while still doing local syntactic work.
topics.reason: The contextual data supports co-occurrence with denial, signs, and punishment, and the same-surah rows tie the use to nearby warning contexts.

topics.headline: sound and boundary texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejection cluster beginning audibly at the boundary where belief in 22:56 is answered by its opposite.
topics.reason: The boundary rows contrast the prior faith outcome with this rejection root, while the phonetic row adds audible texture to that turn.

words.gloss_range: internal coordinating particle adding a second predicate under the same relative subject
words.prose: This inner {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the two rejection verbs cumulative rather than alternative. It visibly separates the two perfect verbs, so the reader hears a hinge from broad inward rejection to targeted outward denial while both acts remain bound to the same relative subject.

topics.headline: cumulative predicate link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rejection and denial as additive predicates rather than interchangeable descriptions.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second verb as coordinated with the first by this internal connector.

topics.headline: visible verb separator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a surface hinge between the two perfect verbs instead of a silent collapse into one idea.
topics.reason: The single-letter particle is its own positioned word between the two verbal predicates.

words.gloss_range: completed plural Form II act of declaring false, directed through the following prepositional complement toward the divine signs
words.root_gloss_range: root range around lying, falsehood, denial, and declaring false; Form II locally selects outward falsification rather than simple lying
words.prose: {{ar:كَذَّبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kadhdhabū}}) is not merely that the subjects lied; Form II makes them declare something else false. The following prepositional complement gives that declaration a target, so broad rejection becomes an outward accusation against the sign-field, carried by the same plural agents as a completed second act. The phrase belongs to the recurring denial-of-signs pattern and gathers same-surah denial language (22:42; 22:44) into verdict, while reversing the righteous-action outcome in 22:50. The doubled middle consonant makes the declarative denial audible.

topics.headline: Form II declarative denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb selecting public declaration of falsity rather than simple false speech.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form II, and the lexical distinction between simple lying and declaring false is locally decisive.

topics.headline: prepositional target of denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial aimed through a marked complement, so the act confronts the signs rather than remaining unattached.
topics.reason: The verb instance has a prepositional complement and attachment evidence forces the sign noun as that governed complement.

topics.headline: same agents in a completed act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second perfect verb adds another completed act by the same plural group.
topics.reason: The 3mp suffix and implicit-subject evidence keep the actors identical with the prior verb inside the same relative clause.

topics.headline: epistemic aggression toward signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial as a hostile judgment cast onto evidence, not as neutral disagreement.
topics.reason: The root field of falsehood is projected through the Form II construction onto the governed object.

topics.headline: denial-sign formula and consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as part of a recurring Quranic denial-of-signs pattern that moves toward punishment.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles support the denial-sign collocation and the local ayah states denial and punishment in one compact movement.

topics.headline: boundary contrast and doubled sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices destructive evidence-denial answering the righteous action in 22:50 while the doubled stem makes the act audible.
topics.reason: The boundary rows contrast the adjacent outcomes, and the Form II stem supplies the audible gemination noted by the phonetic row.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition governing the sign noun and marking the object-like target of denial
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the grammatical bridge that gives denial its object-like target. Its contact or instrument range is locally narrowed by the denial construction, but the bound preposition still makes the act feel engaged with the evidence it rejects. Because it is fused onto the sign noun, the predicate chain visibly closes before the result clause begins.

topics.headline: object-marking bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denial becoming specifically about the signs through a governed prepositional phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following sign noun the syntactically forced complement governed by this preposition.

topics.headline: bound contact pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices object marking as a fused contact relation, while local grammar keeps it from becoming an independent instrumental sense.
topics.reason: The preposition is written as a bound proclitic and completes the predicate chain, but its local function is governed object marking with the denial verb.

words.gloss_range: our signs, verses, and evidentiary markers as the governed target of denial, plural and divinely possessed
words.root_gloss_range: root range around sign, marker, proof, portent, and scriptural verse, with a contested return/refuge derivation preserved only as lexical pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ـَٔايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:ʾāyātinā}}) closes the relative clause by naming the evidence that has been denied. The plural and possessive suffix make the target a divinely owned field of signs, verses, proofs, and portents; the contested return/refuge derivation can add orientation pressure, but the local governed noun still means the speaker's signs. The word gathers both rejection verbs into a familiar evidence-denial pattern and continues the same-surah sign thread (22:16; 22:51; 22:52; 22:72), while its onset gives the named target an audible catch.

topics.headline: governed target of denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the signs locked under the preposition as the target of the denial before the verdict begins.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive with the possessive suffix, and attachment evidence forces it as the prepositional complement of the denial verb.

topics.headline: divinely owned plural evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices multiple signs gathered under one divine speaker, making the denial relationally direct.
topics.reason: The plural noun plus first-person plural possessive suffix presents many evidentiary items as the speaker's own sign-field.

topics.headline: multi-register sign field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is denied is not a single narrow object but a field of signs, verses, portents, proofs, and markers.
topics.reason: The supplied lexical range supports signs, scriptural verses, portents, and evidence, all locally governed as the object of denial.

topics.headline: contested return-pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial also feeling like refusal of orientation or return, while local grammar keeps signs as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is meaningful as lexical pressure, but it does not replace the local governed sign noun.

topics.headline: evidence-denial network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this sign word gathering both rejection verbs into a familiar Quranic evidence-denial pattern.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles and same-surah recurrence support the sign word as a recurring object in denial and consequence frames.

topics.headline: audible arrest at the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational catch at the word that names the evidence target.
topics.reason: The phonetic row ties the hamza onset to the object of denial.

words.gloss_range: resultative particle introducing the consequence of the relative-clause definition
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the conduct-defined relative clause into consequence with immediate sequence. The discourse has moved from the opening coordination to an internal result, so the verdict is not merely appended but follows from the defined rejection. Because the particle is fused to the demonstrative pivot, consequence is attached directly to the re-identification that begins the verdict clause.

topics.headline: quasi-conditional result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment framed as the consequence of the preceding conduct-defined class.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as resultative, and attachment evidence identifies the following nominal clause as the apodosis or resumption.

topics.headline: from pairing to result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from cross-ayah coordination to internal consequence.
topics.reason: The opening connector coordinates with the prior context, while this particle marks the result inside the ayah.

topics.headline: fused result pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices consequence attached directly to the demonstrative pivot that begins the verdict clause.
topics.reason: The result particle is a proclitic on the following demonstrative, making the pivot consequential at the word-shape level.

words.gloss_range: plural far demonstrative re-identifying the conduct-defined group as the subject of the verdict clause
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾulāʾika}}) re-points to the group after their conduct has been stated. The far demonstrative gives exact reference with rhetorical distance, making the verdict clause identify them before assigning the punishment. This belongs to a recurring relative-clause plus result-demonstrative frame (2:5; 3:91; 7:8-9), but here the movement is conduct, distanced identity, then foregrounded allocation.

topics.headline: reidentified verdict subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an extra re-identification step before punishment is named.
topics.reason: QAC marks the demonstrative as the subject of the nominal predicate clause, and attachment evidence says it resumes the relative group.

topics.headline: exact reference with distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the group being precisely targeted while rhetorically distanced.
topics.reason: The far plural demonstrative matches the plural relative group while adding deictic separation.

topics.headline: consequence architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formulaic movement from defined conduct to distanced identity and then to assigned consequence.
topics.reason: The demonstrative participates in a consequence frame with the result particle before it and the fronted allocation after it.

words.gloss_range: preposition of assignment or possession, fronted with its pronoun as the predicate before the punishment noun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the allocation phrase before the punishment is named. Its usual possession or assignment force is grimly inverted here: what is marked as for them is the punishment itself. Fused with the pronoun, it compresses assignment and recipient into the verdict's first predicate unit, making allocation the hinge from demonstrative identity to delayed punishment.

topics.headline: fronted allocation predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipients fixed first, before the allocated punishment is named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the prepositional phrase as the fronted predicate before the delayed punishment noun.

topics.headline: assigned possession of consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices assignment and possession turning the punishment into what belongs to the defined group.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun and creates a possession-assignment phrase in the nominal verdict.

topics.headline: compact recipient marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices assignment and recipient compressed into the clause's first predicate unit.
topics.reason: The preposition combines with the pronoun into a compact fronted phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite third-person masculine plural pronoun governed by the allocation preposition and referring back to the conduct-defined group
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) prevents the allocation from drifting toward an unspecified audience. The same plural agents of rejection and denial are now compressed into the recipient endpoint of the fronted predicate, so the actors become the affected recipients. The pronoun also bridges the demonstrative subject to the delayed punishment noun, carrying the judged group across the clause boundary.

topics.headline: exact plural referent resumed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punishment assigned to exactly the same plural group defined by the earlier verbs.
topics.reason: QAC marks the pronoun as third-person masculine plural referring back to the relative group, and agreement matches the earlier verbal subjects.

topics.headline: affected recipients compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agents of denial becoming the affected recipients inside one bound predicate phrase.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the allocation preposition rather than repeated as a separate noun phrase.

topics.headline: bridge to delayed punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pronoun carrying the judged group across the clause boundary into the punishment assignment.
topics.reason: The pronoun bridges the demonstrative subject and the delayed punishment noun inside the fronted predicate.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative punishment noun, delayed after the fronted recipient phrase and qualified by humiliation
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes punishment and torment alongside sweet or pure water imagery, with the punishment noun locally selected and the sweetness branch retained only as polarity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) lands only after the recipients have been fixed, so the punishment feels assigned before it is named. Its indefiniteness leaves the punishment open and weighty, and the following qualifier locks humiliation onto it rather than letting suffering remain generic. The noun states an established allocation, not a narrated event or a passive label for the punished. The root's sweet-water polarity, visible elsewhere (25:53), survives only as an inversion pressure around the selected torment sense, while the word answers rejection in a familiar consequence pattern and shifts same-surah punishment language (22:25; 22:55) toward humiliation. The paired indefinite cadence makes the noun and qualifier land as one unit as the scene turns from garden-enclosure in 22:56 to assigned punishment.

topics.headline: delayed assigned punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipients fixed before the punishment is named, turning the noun into an allocated reality.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as delayed subject after the fronted predicate, and attachment evidence identifies that predication.

topics.headline: indefinite weight with humiliating quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an unnamed open punishment whose quality is locked to humiliation rather than generic suffering.
topics.reason: The noun and adjective match in nominative indefiniteness, and the adjective relation is strongly licensed.

topics.headline: nominal allocation instead of event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment stated as an established allocation rather than narrated as a finite event or as a label for punished persons.
topics.reason: The local form is an abstract noun in a verbless nominal clause, not a finite punishing verb or passive patient form.

topics.headline: sweet-water polarity inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a root-family polarity where a field that can name sweetness or pure water elsewhere (25:53) is locally turned into torment.
topics.reason: The surface noun selects punishment, while the sweet-water branch remains only as polarity pressure and cannot replace the local torment sense.

topics.headline: punishment formula network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punishment noun answering rejection and joining a recurrent modifier pattern, with this ayah's quality shifting to humiliation.
topics.reason: The contextual rows support co-occurrence with rejection roots and the humiliation modifier, including same-surah punishment contexts.

topics.headline: cadence and outcome-boundary shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punishment phrase closing as a unified sound-pair while the adjacent scene shifts from reward in 22:56 to punishment.
topics.reason: The phonetic row binds noun and adjective by shared cadence, and boundary rows contrast the prior reward scene with this allocation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative Form IV active participle modifying the punishment noun and making humiliation an imposed degrading effect
words.root_gloss_range: root range around lowliness, contemptibility, weakness, service, and humiliation, with the local Form IV participle selecting active causative degradation
words.prose: {{ar:مُّهِينٌ}} ({{tr:muhīnun}}) seals the ayah by specifying not just pain but active degradation. As a Form IV active participle modifying the punishment noun, it makes humiliation something the punishment causes; the root's service, weakness, and contempt field keeps the outcome in the register of lowered status. The choice differs from passive-quality lowliness elsewhere (32:8): here the punishment imposes humiliation. Its strong pairing with the punishment noun makes the final word feel like a recurrent punishment modifier, and the doubled indefinite cadence closes the contrast with the righteous outcome in 22:56.

topics.headline: dependent humiliation qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humiliation locked grammatically onto the punishment noun as its defining quality.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an indefinite nominative modifier, and attachment evidence strongly licenses the adjective relation.

topics.headline: active causative degradation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punishment as actively causing degradation, not merely possessing a humiliating label.
topics.reason: The local tag is active participle, and the Form IV evidence supports causative humiliation.

topics.headline: lowliness and service field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the humiliation as status-lowering, colored by lowliness, weakness, service, and contempt.
topics.reason: The local participle selects active humiliation, while the broader root field supplies concrete status-lowering pressure.

topics.headline: active form over passive quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the choice of an active humiliator-form rather than a mere contemptible-state adjective, with the passive-quality contrast visible elsewhere (32:8).
topics.reason: The local form is active participial, while qualitative uses remain contrastive evidence and do not control the local parse.

topics.headline: concentrated punishment modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word as part of a recurrent punishment-modifier register rather than an isolated adjective.
topics.reason: The contextual rows show strong concentration with the punishment noun and an adjective/modifier deployment pattern.

topics.headline: closing degradation cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices degradation arriving as the final semantic and acoustic landing of the ayah.
topics.reason: The adjective is postposed after the punishment noun and repeats the nominal cadence at the ayah's close.

topics.headline: outcome contrast at boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the negative outcome ending in imposed degradation in contrast with the righteous outcome in 22:56.
topics.reason: Boundary and synthesis rows identify the final phrase as an indefinite punishment whose defining action is degradation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated verbs at words 2-3 act on the signs at word 4, followed by the paired consequence at words 7-8.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible marker is first covered and then assigned falsehood. The consequence joins pain to public loss of standing, reversing the attempted suppression by making the suppressors' own condition manifest.

activation_trace.role: Concealment of acknowledged truth supplies epistemic covering and functions as the first stage of suppression.
Attributing falsehood supplies a social verdict and functions as the second stage of discrediting the signs.
A manifest marker supplies something publicly legible and functions as the object that covering cannot erase.
Severe pain and penalty supply the punitive force and function as the consequence of the two acts.
Humiliation through being treated as slight supplies a status loss and functions as public reversal of the attempted verdict.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely assigns a painful punishment to people holding two wrong beliefs.
changed_reading.after: The ayah answers a coordinated act of covering and public discrediting with pain plus an exposure that reverses the deniers' claimed authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch range of the act at word 2 and the punishment-description at words 7-8 permits a benefit-withholding mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealing a received good or refusing its acknowledgment is answered by withholding and by reducing what had been treated as available for use. Punishment can therefore include deprivation and loss of entitlement, not only added pain.

activation_trace.role: Concealing a benefit supplies ingratitude and functions as a refusal to acknowledge received support.
Withholding or weaning supplies deprivation and functions as the removal of a presumed support.
Debasement through use supplies loss of valued standing and functions as the social effect of removed entitlement.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is only an externally inflicted torment.
changed_reading.after: The punishment may also withdraw unacknowledged goods and strip the standing of those who treated support as an unowned entitlement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two active plural verbs precede a demonstrative verdict, allowing the denial at word 3 to be heard as an attempted operation rather than a static opinion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deniers deliberately target the signs and launch a discrediting advance. Branches in which a charge fails or an animal's run stops make that advance non-durable; the demeaning outcome displays the weakness of a campaign that could not carry through.

activation_trace.role: A charge tested by whether it carries through supplies campaign imagery and functions as a failed assault on credibility.
A run that stops and looks back supplies interrupted momentum and functions as the denial campaign's failure to persist.
Deliberately aiming at a person's distinguishing sign supplies targeting and functions as the campaign's directed object.
Loss of strength and resolve supplies incapacity and functions as the disclosed endpoint of the failed advance.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a settled proposition in the deniers' minds.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also an attempted campaign against the signs whose inability to sustain itself is exposed by the final verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes receptive lowering from imposed abasement. Prostration and hearts settling low preserve a dignified gentleness, whereas being made low with no restorer of honor is coercive status loss; the focus adjective marks the latter, not lowliness as such.

activation_trace.role: Quiet, dignified gentleness supplies a non-degrading low posture and functions as the live contrast within the focus root.
Humiliation by being treated as slight supplies forced abasement and functions as the focus consequence.
Bowing down supplies voluntary lowering and functions as the context's non-humiliating mode of submission.
Being made low supplies imposed disgrace and functions as the direct contextual gloss on the focus adjective.
Bestowed honor supplies the opposite status and functions as what no agent can restore after imposed abasement.
Low, tranquil open ground supplies receptive settling and functions as the heart's voluntary alternative to humiliation.

structural_cues: 22:18 places prostration, deserved punishment, imposed lowering, and absent honor in one sequence; 22:54 later gives receptive hearts a different kind of lowering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two low postures and an explicit honor contrast; I infer that refusal of receptive lowering ends in forced lowering, while the live alternative is that the passages merely contrast populations without a causal conversion.

changed_reading.before: Muhin means generic insult or low rank.
changed_reading.after: Muhin is coerced loss of honor, sharply distinguished from the quiet and voluntary lowering by which receptive persons retain dignity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier use joins disbelief to blocking a path and a sacred space declared equally available. Covering and discrediting signs therefore becomes institutional gatekeeping: controlling who may approach, not merely holding an inward proposition.

activation_trace.role: Concealing truth supplies the focus act and functions as the epistemic side of access control.
Assigning falsehood supplies delegitimation and functions as the gatekeeper's public rationale.
Turning away and repelling supply obstruction and function as the enacted form of disbelief.
An extended traversable road supplies access and functions as what the obstruction closes.
Equality between parties supplies shared standing and functions as the norm violated by gatekeeping.
Deviation from a straight course supplies misdirection and functions as the obstructive mechanism's legal-moral turn.

structural_cues: 22:25 coordinates kafaru with the continuing act of repelling and locates that act in a space declared equal for resident and visitor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjunction, obstruction, a road, and equal access; I infer that sign-covering scales into control of approach, while the live alternative is that obstruction is one associated offense rather than part of kufr's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns private disbelief and verbal denial.
changed_reading.after: The focus also reaches a social program that discredits signs in order to regulate access, with humiliation reversing the gatekeepers' claimed standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first pairs intensive ingratitude with breached trust, then places the same root after received life, death, and restored life. The focus act can thus be read as concealing dependence and breaking reciprocity toward sustaining gifts.

activation_trace.role: Concealing a benefit supplies ingratitude and functions as the focus model being strengthened.
Deficient fidelity supplies betrayal and functions as the relational frame for intensive ingratitude.
Concealment of benefit supplies explicit contextual ingratitude and functions as the breached response paired with treachery.
Life as benefit supplies received good and functions as the dependency that human ingratitude erases.
Loss of life and power supplies the interruption and functions as evidence that life is not self-secured.
Intensive concealment of benefit supplies the sequence's verdict and functions as the contextual key to the focus verb.

structural_cues: 22:38 collocates betrayal and intensive kufr; 22:66 places intensive kufr after the life-death-life sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breached fidelity and a repeated life gift before kafur; I infer a reciprocity arrow from received support to owed acknowledgment, while the live alternative keeps kufr primarily as theological rejection.

changed_reading.before: Kafaru names denial detached from any prior receipt.
changed_reading.after: Kafaru can name a breach by beneficiaries who conceal the very dependence and renewed life from which their agency comes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The signs sit in a contested transmission process: an alien insertion is cast into recitation, then removed, after which the signs are made firm and recognized as truth. Covering and denial become attachment to a counterfeit layer after the signal has been filtered and stabilized.

activation_trace.role: A covering layer supplies concealment and functions as the model for interference laid over a sign.
A surface that misreports its own condition supplies counterfeit appearance and functions as denial's misleading layer.
A manifest sign supplies the underlying signal and functions as what remains identifiable through interference.
Recitation placed in ordered positions supplies a transmission channel and functions as the site into which interference enters.
Throwing something into a site supplies insertion and functions as the adversarial addition to the channel.
Removal followed by a replacement supplies filtering and functions as elimination of the alien insertion.
Tightening into a reliable form supplies stabilization and functions as confirmation of the signs after filtering.
Testing a person or material supplies discrimination and functions as the divergent response produced by interference.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies truth and functions as the recognized status of the filtered sign.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders casting, removal, and confirmation; 22:53-54 then split diseased or hardened reception from knowledgeable recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a transmission sequence and divergent reception; I infer a signal-filter-counterfeit mechanism, while the live alternative confines the sequence to prophetic transmission rather than opponents' conscious technique.

changed_reading.before: The deniers simply refuse evidence that arrived in an uncontested form.
changed_reading.after: They attach themselves to counterfeit interference even after it is exposed and removed, then keep discrediting the stabilized sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ongoing doubt behaves as a regime of postponement until a sudden, barren day closes it. Branches of waiting and failed continuity make denial a temporizing performance whose apparent duration produces no future and ends without another review interval.

activation_trace.role: A supply expected to continue but failing supplies false durability and functions as the temporal weakness of denial.
Pausing and waiting supply temporal suspension and function as the interval in which signs are kept unresolved.
Continuance in the construction of persistence supplies duration and functions as doubt's extended regime.
Oscillating doubt supplies unresolved judgment and functions as what the deniers prolong.
Sudden arrival supplies abrupt closure and functions as the end of postponement without a final delay.
Failure to generate offspring supplies barrenness and functions as the absence of any productive future for continued doubt.

structural_cues: The until-clause in 22:55 terminates an explicitly continuing state with either sudden arrival or the punishment of a barren day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistence, doubt, suddenness, and barrenness; I infer that delay is being used as an epistemic strategy, while the live alternative treats the grammar as duration alone with no strategic agency.

changed_reading.before: The focus announces punishment at an unspecified later time.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes a deliberately prolonged suspension: denial lasts, but it cannot reproduce a future or secure one more interval for revision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby legal sequence sets response against equivalent injury, distinguishes renewed aggression, and keeps pardon and protective covering live. This weakens a reading of the focus punishment as uncontrolled vengeance: its humiliating quality need not imply excess beyond adjudicated consequence.

activation_trace.role: Penalty and severe pain supply the focus sanction and function as the reading being bounded.
Consequence following an offense supplies juridical sequence and functions as the sanction's measured frame.
Equivalence between counterparts supplies proportionality and functions as a limit on retaliatory excess.
Crossing a boundary through aggression supplies excess and functions as the condition distinguished from measured response.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supply pardon and function as a still-live alternative to enforcement.
Covering a fault while shielding its bearer from effect supplies mercy and functions as the boundary around punitive reading.

structural_cues: 22:60 places equivalence, subsequent aggression, divine support, pardon, and forgiveness in one compact legal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportional response and mercy language; I infer that this nearby norm constrains how punishment is imagined, while the live alternative is that 22:60 governs human retaliation and does not directly delimit eschatological judgment.

changed_reading.before: A humiliating punishment implies an unbounded retaliatory excess.
changed_reading.after: The adjective names a real status consequence within judgment, but nearby proportionality and pardon weaken any inference of uncontrolled vengeance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth and falsehood are ranked, then invoked powers fail even to recover what a fly takes, and that failure is named bad estimation of divine measure before strength and might are asserted. Humiliation becomes disclosure of actual capacity and rank rather than arbitrary name-calling.

activation_trace.role: Lowliness and weakness supply deficient capacity and function as one dimension of the focus adjective.
Public humiliation supplies status loss and functions as the social disclosure of deficient capacity.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies true standing and functions as the standard of rank.
Loss of truth and stability supplies null standing and functions as the status of rival claims.
Prevailing elevation supplies superior rank and functions as the contrast to the focus humiliation.
Extraction from another's grasp supplies rescue capacity and functions through its explicit failure.
The opposite of strength supplies exposed weakness and functions as the verdict on both seeker and sought.
Measuring a thing to its proper limit supplies valuation and functions as the diagnostic act the deniers fail.
Strength gathered like strands in a rope supplies effective power and functions as the reality missed by bad valuation.
Overmastering might supplies prevailing capacity and functions as the final contrast to exposed impotence.

structural_cues: 22:62 opposes truth and falsehood with highness; 22:73 stages failed creation and failed recovery; 22:74 diagnoses failed estimation and answers it with strength and might.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rank contrast, a capacity test, and failed valuation; I infer that humiliation reveals objective dependency and mismeasured power, while the live alternative treats the fly parable as a separate critique of objects of worship.

changed_reading.before: The punishment humiliates by attaching a degrading label from outside.
changed_reading.after: The punishment humiliates by exposing the deniers' and their substitutes' actual inability, null standing, and radically mistaken scale of power.

context_deltas.mechanism: When clear signs are recited, denial becomes recognizable on faces and approaches bodily assault. Covering is therefore leaky: the attempted inward and verbal rejection manifests publicly, then converts into coercion against those carrying the signs.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies attempted concealment and functions as the posture that visibly fails to contain itself.
A charge enacted as an advance supplies aggressive discrediting and functions as the bridge from verdict to coercion.
Manifest signs supply repeated public evidence and function as the stimulus the reaction cannot hide.
Becoming exposed and plain supplies clarity and functions as the condition that intensifies the reaction.
Recognition from an identifying trace supplies legibility and functions as the observer's access to concealed hostility.
The visible face supplies a public surface and functions as the site where rejection becomes readable.
Refusal of recognition supplies denial and functions as the affect displayed on the face.
Near completion of an act supplies imminence and functions as the threshold between expression and assault.

structural_cues: 22:72 word 13, root س ط و, supplies the near-assault action; it remains structural because the packet provides no branch inventory for that root.
The ayah repeats the signs before and after the facial reaction, enclosing the movement from recitation to coercive response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear recitation, readable faces, and a nearly performed assault; I infer that failed concealment spills into coercion, while the live alternative treats the facial and bodily response as an episode rather than the stable mechanism of every denier.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib is only a spoken claim that signs are false.
changed_reading.after: Takdhib can be an embodied escalation: visible aversion to clear signs approaches force against their reciters, making the later humiliation a public reversal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the root-distant uncovered-to-the-sky branch of punishment rather than the ordinary pain sense. It remains anchored in the focus contrast between covering signs and the punishment noun; downstream prose should present it only as a material counter-image, not as a lexical translation of adhab.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covering verb at word 2, visible signs at word 4, and punishment at word 7 form an ironic cover-versus-exposure sequence.

activation_trace.role: Physical covering supplies shelter and concealment and functions as the act reversed by exposure.
A visible marker supplies what the cover hides and functions as the resistant object that remains legible.
Standing with no cover between body and sky supplies exposure and functions as the ironic counter-cover.
Humiliation supplies public vulnerability and functions as the social consequence of being uncovered.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an added force unrelated to the deniers' covering act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sign-coverers undergo a counter-cover: their own condition is left exposed and publicly slighted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two concrete garment branches across different focus roots. It remains anchored in the adjacent covering and denial verbs plus the split inventory for muhin; downstream prose should mark it as an image of reputational exposure, not claim that the verse literally describes stripping clothes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 2-3 create a covering and false-surface pair, while the non-dominant mapped branch at word 8 supplies a garment-removal motion.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies an outer layer and functions as concealment of the sign beneath it.
A decorated cloth that misstates its condition supplies deceptive presentation and functions as the deniers' counterfeit surface.
Pulling a garment supplies removal of an outer layer and functions as exposure of the counterfeit presentation.
Debasing something through use supplies loss of prestige and functions as the reputational result of the stripping image.

changed_reading.before: The two verbs are abstract judgments and muhin merely adds emotional shame.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial fabricates a misleading outer garment that the consequence pulls away, exposing and devaluing its makers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates sweetness and withholding inside the punishment root through the immediate contrast with good provision and a satisfying entrance. It remains focus-anchored at adhab and muhin and context-backed by 22:58-59; downstream prose should frame it as contrastive deprivation, not replace the ordinary punishment sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The punishment noun at word 7 can carry a withholding branch, while the adjective at word 8 makes exclusion a loss of standing.

activation_trace.role: Sweet and agreeable intake supplies the positive good and functions as what the next ayat contrastively distribute elsewhere.
Withholding and weaning supply deprivation and function as exclusion from the agreeable good.
Humiliation supplies lowered standing and functions as the social quality of exclusion.
An apportioned gift supplies positive provision and functions as the immediate alternative destination after the focus verdict.
Entry into an interior supplies admission and functions as the welcome denied by contrast to the punished group.
Contented acceptance supplies satisfaction and functions as the affective opposite of humiliating exclusion.

changed_reading.before: The punished receive pain while the next group independently receives reward.
changed_reading.after: Contrastively, punishment also reads as humiliating exclusion from good provision, welcome, and satisfaction distributed immediately afterward.

strongest_changes: Disbelief and denial shifted from private propositions to active covering, gatekeeping, and eventually embodied coercion against access to signs.
The transmission sequence made denial attachment to a counterfeit layer after alien material is removed and the signs are stabilized as truth.
Muhin shifted from generic insult to forced loss of honor and exposed incapacity, while remaining distinct from voluntary, dignified lowering.
Punishment retained severe pain but also activated deprivation and exclusion, with nearby proportionality and pardon constraining an unbounded-vengeance reading.
summary.what_was_special: The split mappings under ه و ن kept quiet ease, humiliation, debasement through use, garment pulling, and weakness simultaneously live. Combined with distant but anchored branches of ك ذ ب and ع ذ ب, they produced reversals of cover, transmission, status, timing, and hospitality that a single consensus gloss would suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant mappings under ه و ن are activation material, not a morphological decision about the surface form.
The campaign and signal-filter arrows are reader-supplied mechanisms; the packet guarantees their components but not those causal directions.
The legal proportionality of 22:60 and hospitality contrast of 22:58-59 may constrain or illuminate the focus judgment without defining its full scope.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Covered and declared-false signs return as exposing abasement.** `ك ف ر B003/B001` rejects by covering; `ك ذ ب B002` declares false; `ء ي ي B003` visible sign; `ه و ن B003` humiliation by contempt; `ع ذ ب B005` punishment. The two acts suppress visibility and truth-status. I infer a reversal in which judgment strips the deniers of the standing used to dismiss the signs. *Muhīn* reads as public exposure proportionate to deliberate concealment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:72 intensified exposure by locating the condemned reaction in faces before naming fire as destination, making humiliation a revealed orientation before punishment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Concealing and denying visible signs returns as public abasement.** Fixed `كَفَرُوا` activates `ك ف ر:B003` (covering or rejecting truth), `كَذَّبُوا` uses `ك ذ ب:B002`, and the object `ءَايَات` uses `ء ي ي:B003` (visible signs). The outcome `مُّهِين` activates `ه و ن:B003` (humiliation and abasement through contempt). `22:56` supplied adjudicative separation; `22:58-59` contrast noble provision and satisfying entry. The packet supplies hidden rejection of visibility and later status exposure; I infer a reversal from covering evidence to being openly lowered. The punishment's humiliating quality is relationally fitted to the act.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:58-59` provide the status-reversal's positive side: those physically displaced or killed receive noble provision and an entry they approve, making humiliation more clearly relational than merely painful.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi örtme ve görünmez kılma çekirdeğini; zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme, külün toprakla kapanması ve yıldızların güneş ışığında görünmemesi gibi gerçekleşmelerle açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın örtme çekirdeğini korur; zırh, silah, kül ve gök cisimleriyle ilgili kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
Zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme ve külün üstünün toprakla kapanması çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; farklı örnekler bu işlemin nesne, giysi, silah, kül ve gök görünümü üzerindeki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gönderimi ekim yapan çiftçidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ekim süreci ile genel çiftçi adı, eylem ve eyleyen sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر للزارع والكفار للزراع لأنهم يغطون الحب أو البذر بالتراب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافر المضاد للإيمان ولا الكافر للبحر أو الليل
branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال للزارع كافر لأنه يغطى الحب بتراب الأرض (maqayis)؛ الكافر الزارع لأنه يغطي البذر بالتراب (sihah)؛ الزراع لستره البذر في الأرض (mufradat)؛ الكفار الزراع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi günahı veya bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü belirli bir karşılıkla örtme, silme ve işlenmemiş gibi kılma sürecini açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnızca bağışlama değildir; günah veya bozulmuş yemin karşısında yükü gideren bir işlem ya da karşılık bulunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Günah yükünü giderme çekirdeği korunur; bozulmuş yemin için gerekeni yapma yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı özel gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir günahın ya da bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü, gereken karşılığı veya işlemi yerine getirerek örtmek, silmek ve işlenmemiş sayılacak duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
Bozulan yemin için gereken yükümlülüğü yerine getirme, çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel türüdür.
İşlemin sonucu, kötülüğün işlenmemiş gibi değerlendirilmesi veya etkisinin silinmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar günahın veya yeminin yükünü gideren karşılıkta birleşir; toplu anlatım hem gereken eylemi hem de günahın silinmiş sayılması sonucunu korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem giderici işlemi hem de günahın etkisinin silinmesi sonucunu kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Günah yükünün bir karşılık veya işlemle ortadan kaldırılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yemin bozulduğunda doğan özel yükümlülüğün yerine getirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bozulan yemin nedeniyle gereken karşılığın yerine getirilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemin dışındaki günah ve kötülüklerin giderilmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İşlemin günahı işlenmemiş gibi kılan sonucunun öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Günahın etkisini ve yükünü ortadan kaldırma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: günahı veya bozulan yeminin yükünü gideren karşılık
bozulan yeminin gerektirdiği yükümlülüğü yerine getirme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal günah veya yemin yükünü belirli bir karşılık ya da işlemle giderir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hak edilmiş cezayı uygulamamayı ve suçu bağışlayarak silmeyi merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Günahın sonucunu ortadan kaldırma ve onu silinmiş sayma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda giderici karşılık veya yükümlülük belirleyicidir; komşu dalda belirleyici olan cezadan vazgeçme ve bağışlamadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçmiş eylemin yükünü gideren karşılığı veya işlemi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin günahtan dönmesini ve davranış yönünü değiştirmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da işlenmiş bir günahla ilişkiyi değiştiren dinî-ahlaki bir süreçtir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak yükün silinmesidir; komşu dalda odak kişinin geri dönüşü ve davranışı bırakmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bağışlama ile günahtan dönme, giderici işlem ile sonuç arasındaki sınırı en iyi açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفارة لما يكفر الخطيئة أو اليمين والتكفير للسيئات والمعاصي حتى تصير كأن لم تعمل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكفر ضد الإيمان ولا كفران النعمة ولا ستر الأشياء الحسية
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفارة ما يكفر به من الخطيئة واليمين فيمحى به (ayn)؛ تكفير اليمين فعل ما يجب بالحنث فيها والاسم الكفارة والتكفير في المعاصي (sihah)؛ الكفارة ما يغطي الإثم والتكفير ستره وتغطيته حتى يصير بمنزلة ما لم يعمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiçek veya meyveyi örten bitkisel kapta birleşir; üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği ve meyve yaprağı bu üst kavramın farklı gönderimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üzüm ve hurma dâhil gelişen bitki bölümünü örten kap veya yaprağı genel olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örtücü bitkisel yapıyı ve çiçek ile meyve kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz hurma ağacından çıkan çiçek kabını gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma çiçeğini örten kap biçimli bitki yapısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üzüm salkımının veya hurma çiçeğinin kılıfı
hurma çiçeğinin ya da meyvenin kılıfı
hurma ağacından çıkan kapalı çiçek kılıfları

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği veya meyvenin dış kılıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca başaktaki tek bir tahıl tanesinin ince örtüsünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir bitki üreme yapısını dıştan örten doğal kılıf iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtülen bölüm ve yapı ölçeği farklıdır: bu dal salkım, çiçek veya meyve kabıdır; komşu dal tanenin başak içindeki ince örtüsüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal örtücü kılıfın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ekinin kendi kılıfına girip korunmuş duruma gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelişen bitki ürününün doğal bir kılıf içinde korunması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adıdır; komşu dal ürünün kılıf içine girme aşamasını ve durumunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tahıl tanesi örtüsü ve ekinin kılıfa girme durumu, nesne ve gelişim aşaması sınırlarını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور والكفرى والكوافير لأكمام العنب أو طلع النخل أو الورقة التي تستر الثمرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافور الطيب ولا عين الماء ولا النبات ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وسمى كافورا لأنه كفر الوليع أي غطاه (maqayis)؛ الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وكافوره ورقة الذي يستره والكافور الطلع والكفرى والكوافير (ayn)؛ الكافور الطلع ووعاء طلع النخل وكذلك الكفرى (sihah)؛ الكافور اسم أكمام الثمرة التي تكفرها والكافور أكمام الثمرة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kavramsal tür vermek yerine aynı sözle anılan üç ayrı gönderimi sıralar: güzel kokulu bir madde, cennetteki bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki. Tanım bu nedenle birleşik bir nesne sınıfı kurmadan sözlüksel çokanlamlılık kümesi olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç gönderim birbirinin örneği değildir; dal yalnızca kaynakta aynı ad altında toplanan bu ayrı sözlük anlamlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin üç ayrı gönderimi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir; meyve ve çiçek kılıfı anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözle adlandırılan üç ayrı gönderimden oluşan bir sözlük kümesidir: güzel kokulu bir karışım maddesi, cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki.

facets.statement: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan bir madde.
Cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı.
Çiçeği papatya çiçeğine benzeyen bir bitki.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı güzel kokulu madde anlamını ortaklaştırır; aynı aggregate aktarım ayrıca su kaynağı ve papatyaya benzer çiçekli bitki anlamlarını ayrı gönderimler olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: koku maddesi, su kaynağı veya bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Birbirinden ayrı üç sözlük gönderimini yapay bir ortak nesne türüne indirgemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı gönderimin tamamını ve aralarındaki tür ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün güzel koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan madde gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Su kaynağı ve çiçekli bitki gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın güzel kokulu madde yanında su kaynağı ve ayrı bir bitki gönderimi de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel kokulu kökü olan belirli bitkileri ve onlardan elde edilen kokuyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güzel koku veren bitkisel madde alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan yalnızca koku maddesi yönüdür; gönderimler ve bu dalın öteki iki sözlük anlamı farklı olduğu için ikame edilemezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca güzel kokulu bitki ve madde adayı bir facet için yararlı alan karşılaştırması sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور من الطيب وعين ماء في الجنة والنبات المسمى كافورا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس أكمام الثمر ولا الطلع ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور شيء من أخلاط الطيب والكافور عين ماء في الجنة والكافور نبات نوره كنور الأقحوان (ayn)؛ الكافور من الطيب (sihah)؛ الكافور الذي هو من الطيب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlardan uzak araziyi temel gönderim olarak verir; köy, köyler, bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar anlamları ise aynı söz ailesinin ayrı sözlük kullanımlarıdır. Tanım bunları tek bir 'ıssız yer' nesnesi gibi özdeşleştirmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzak arazi çekirdeği ile köy, halk ve mezar kullanımları ayrı facetlerdir; dağ geçidi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzak araziye bağlı söz öbeği ile yalın köy, mezar ve çoğul yer-halk kullanımları ayrı tutulur; kapsamları tek anlamda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlardan uzak, pek inilmez ve geçilmez bir araziyi anlatır. Aynı söz ailesinde köy, köyler veya bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar için kaydedilmiş ayrı kullanımlar da bulunur.

facets.statement: İnsanlardan uzak, pek uğranmayan veya geçilmeyen arazi.
Köy, köyler ve uzak yerlerin halkı aynı söz ailesinin ayrı yer ve topluluk kullanımlarıdır.
Mezar anlamı tek kaynaklı aktarım içinde verilen ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlardan uzak arazi anlamında birleşir; toplu kanıt ayrıca köy, köylerin halkı ve mezar anlamlarını ortak çekirdekten ayrılması gereken sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.

concept_gloss.text: uzak arazi; köy, uzak yer halkı veya mezar
concept_gloss.applicability: Ana uzak arazi anlamını öne alır ve kaynakta aynı dalda tutulan ayrı yer kullanımlarını açıkça işaretler.

error_profile.preserves: Uzak arazi çekirdeğini; köy, uzak yer halkı ve mezar varyantlarından ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz öbeğinin pek uğranmayan uzak araziyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklık ve insan uğrağından yoksunluk özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Köy, halk ve mezar kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanlardan uzak araziyi öne çıkarır ve köy ile mezarı ayrı sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü sınırlı yeri; mamur, boş, yerleşik veya ıssız oluşuna bakmadan genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Arazi, köy ve mezar gibi yer gönderimleri iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli sözlük gönderimlerine ve uzaklık koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği genel yer kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın ana yeri insanlardan uzak arazidir; ayrıca köy ve mezar kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir yer adı yanında deniz içindeki veya karadan kopuk adayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan yerleşiminden ya da ana karadan ayrılık düşüncesi iki dalı yakınlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklık insanlarla ilişkilidir; komşu dalda fiziksel kopukluk ve ada yapısı belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yer kavramı ile fiziksel kopuk yer, uzaklık koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر من الأرض البعيد عن الناس والكفور للقرى والكفر للقرية والقبر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الثنايا من الجبال ولا البحر ولا الليل ولا الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر من الأرض ما بعد من الناس وأهل الكفور والقرى (maqayis)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس والكفور القرى (ayn)؛ الكفر أيضا القرية والكفر أيضا القبر (sihah)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ geçitlerini, iri bir dağı ve alçak duvarı aynı söz ailesinde sıralar; geçitleri 'örtülü' saymak kaynakta kurucu bir koşul değildir. Dal bu nedenle örtülülük altında birleştirilmeden coğrafi çekirdek ve ayrı duvar kullanımı olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dağ geçidi ve iri dağ coğrafi facetlerdir; alçak duvar ayrı bir sözlük varyantıdır, köy veya uzak arazi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimleri ayrı tutulur; uzak yer veya genel örtme anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dağlar arasındaki geçitler veya iri bir dağ için kullanılan coğrafi bir adlandırmadır; aynı söz ailesinde alçak duvar anlamı da ayrı bir sözlük kullanımı olarak kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Dağlar arasındaki geçit veya geçitler.
İri bir dağ, coğrafi alan içindeki ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.
Alçak duvar, coğrafi çekirdekten ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların çoğu dağ geçitlerini verir; toplu kanıt iri dağ ve alçak duvar anlamlarını da aynı söz ailesinin ayrı varyantları olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: dağ geçidi; iri dağ veya alçak duvar
concept_gloss.applicability: Dağ geçidi çekirdeğini öne alırken aynı dalda korunan iki ayrı sözlük varyantını da eksiltmeden gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimlerini birbirinden ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul veya tekil biçimin dağlar arasındaki geçidi gösterdiği coğrafi bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık arazideki geçit gönderimini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dağ geçidi yanında iri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geçidi özellikle dağ veya vadideki yol kıvrımı ve yürünür güzergâh olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazideki geçit iki dalın ortak gönderimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Geçit gönderiminde yakınlık yüksektir; ancak komşu dal yolun kıvrım ve güzergâh yapısını, bu dal ise ayrı dağ ve duvar varyantlarını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçidin yalnızca dağlık yer türünü adlandırır ve zorluk koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dik, engebeli ve çıkılması güç bir dağ yolunu veya benzer yükseltileri merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazide geçiş sağlayan yer iki dalda da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeğinde sarplık veya tırmanış şartı yoktur; komşu dalda güç çıkılan yükselen yol belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dağ geçidi ile sarp dağ yolu, geçit türünün ve zorluk koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفرات والثنايا من الجبال والكفر العظيم من الجبال والحائط الواطئ
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القرية ولا القبر ولا الأرض البعيدة العامة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفرات والكفر الثنايا من الجبال (maqayis)؛ الكفر الثنايا من الجبال (ayn)؛ الكفر العظيم من الجبال (sihah)؛ الكافر الحائط الواطىء (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başla işaret etme ile eli göğse koyup bedenini alçaltmayı, başka birine boyun eğme gösterisinin iki bedensel gerçekleşmesi olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel içsel alçakgönüllülük değil, baş veya el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli bir boyun eğme gösterisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adı belirli bedensel boyun eğme hareketleriyle sınırlanır; günah giderme veya kişiyi inançsız sayma anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup bedenini alçaltması yoluyla başka birine boyun eğdiğini göstermesidir.

facets.statement: Bedeni alçaltan bir hareketle başka birine boyun eğme gösterisi yapma.
Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup eğilmesi, bu gösterinin belirtilen bedensel biçimleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başka birine bedensel olarak boyun eğme çekirdeğinde birleşir; başla işaret ve eli göğse koyarak eğilme iki farklı hareket biçimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tutumdan çok baş, el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli gösteriyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel eğilmeyi, yöneldiği kişiyi ve boyun eğme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğmesi
contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğme işareti yaptığı tarihî bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla yaptığı boyun eğme işaretini korur.
error_profile.loses: Elin göğse konduğu ve bütün bedenin alçaldığı biçimi dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: başını eğmek veya elini göğsüne koyup eğilmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başla işaret veya eli göğse koyup eğilme gibi belirli bir kişiye yönelmiş hareketleri şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal içsel alçalışı, ses ve bakışın sakinleşmesini, ibadet duruşunu ve genel gönüllü boyun eğmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Başın ve bedenin alçaltılmasıyla boyun eğme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli törensel beden hareketidir; komşu dal daha geniş bir içsel ve dışsal alçakgönüllülük alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda alnı yere koymak şart değildir; baş işareti veya göğüste elle eğilme yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal alnı yere koymayı ve secde biçimindeki boyun eğmeyi de çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bedeni alçaltarak itaat ve saygı gösterme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hareketin biçimi farklıdır: bu dal ayakta yapılan eğilme işaretlerini, komşu dal yere kapanmaya kadar uzanan secdeyi kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel alçakgönüllülük ve yere kapanma, bu dalın belirli beden hareketi sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التكفير بمعنى إيماء الذمي برأسه أو وضع اليد على الصدر والتطامن خضوعا

branches.source_phrase_ar: التكفير إيماء الذمي برأسه لا يقال سجد له وإنما يقال كفر له (ayn)؛ التكفير أن يخضع الإنسان لغيره يضع يده على صدره ويتطامن له (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemini hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini açıkça verir; ancak geçici dal imgesindeki tacın örttüğü düşüncesi bir kaynak iddiası değildir. Süreç ve nesne ayrımı korunarak aynı dalda gösterilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hükümdarlık tacı ve taç giydirme töreniyle sınırlıdır; genel baş örtüsü veya boyun eğme hareketi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adının taç giydirme süreci ve taç nesnesi gönderimleri birlikte fakat ayrı facetlerde korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemidir; aynı söz bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemi.
Taçlandırma işleminde kullanılan tacın kendisi için aktarılan nesne anlamı.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı kanıt, hükümdarı taçlandırma süreci ile bu süreçte kullanılan taç nesnesini aynı sözün iki bağlı gönderimi olarak kaydeder.

source_details.summary: Söz hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemi hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın adı olarak aktarılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Süreç ile nesne gönderimini birbirine indirgemeden aynı sözlük alanında birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Taçlandırma işlemini, hükümdar katılımcısını ve taç nesnesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün törensel işlemi bildirdiği eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hükümdarın başına taç koyma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tacın kendisini adlandıran nesne gönderimini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: hükümdara taç giydirme veya tacın kendisi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle hükümdara taç giydirme işlemini ve tacın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal taç yanında sarık bağlamayı, kişiyi başa geçirmeyi ve egemenlik işaretini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Baş üzerine taç koyma ve bunu egemenlik işareti yapma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal taç ve hükümdarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal sarık, başa geçirme ve topluluğun kişiyi önder sayması gibi daha geniş süreçleri de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal taç giydirme eylemini ve hükümdarlık tacını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başa süs veya örtü olarak konan sarık, başlık, taç ve bitki gibi nesneleri genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Taç, başın üstüne konan bir nesne olarak iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal hükümdarlık ve taçlandırma işlevine bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği başa konan nesnelerin genel sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; egemenlik için baş bağlama ve genel baş süsü dalları, taçlandırmanın işlevsel sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
